text:
ops-bot: Pager: EU embeddings routing failures, high 5xx rate detected across eu-central-1. Routing fallback active.

sanjay: I'm on it. Paging infra.

andre: looking at the router logs now, seeing KV cache misses and a spike in connection resets.

sanjay: can we toggle fallback to smaller model for EU customers while we investigate?

andre: yes, can flip to embed-model-v2-small as fallback. ETA 5m.

emma: Heads up support — prepare a statuspage initial note. I'll draft and paste below for quick review.

maria: cc @support @sales — customers in EU could see degraded embedding quality/latency.

emma: Draft for status page (initial):
```
Investigating — We are seeing elevated errors and latency for embeddings requests from EU region (eu-central-1). Our engineering team is actively investigating and has enabled an automated routing fallback to reduce impact. API may return degraded quality or increased latency for affected requests. We'll post updates here. No workaround required for most customers.
```

andre: fallback rolled out to 80% of traffic at 10:06 UTC. errors dropping but still some flaps.

sanjay: update for status page (10:10 UTC):
```
10:06 UTC — Automated fallback to smaller model enabled for affected traffic. Error rate decreasing; some requests may still experience timeouts. Engineers continuing root cause analysis.
```

lia: quick legal note — avoid implying data loss. remove any language suggesting 'data lost'.

emma: updated wording per legal, replacing 'data loss' bits. New initial note above.

maria: support note ready:
- Customers may see higher latency and slightly different embedding vectors
- No action required; we will update when resolved

andre: mitigation: we've pinned kernel to older release on router nodes; monitoring for 15m.

sanjay: will draft resolved notice once stabilized 30m of normal metrics.

emma: final resolved draft when ready will include timeline and impact summary.

ops-bot: Incident tagged: embeddings-eu-routing-2026-03-17, severity: p2

maria: filing customer follow-up template now.

sanjay: thanks all. I'm staying on call until metrics fully normalized :thumbsup:
